notes: A cleaner tavern and a more reliable journey. Modernized player HUD and menus; polished mugs, the front door, walls, shelves, barrels and lighting. Fixes protect saved progress, preserve quest gifts and daily requests, and settle served meals before sleep or quitting. Harvested crops no longer leave floating outlines; reward indicators, patron speech and the ending message fit cleanly on screen. Verified with three new-game campaigns through the ending and 268 regression checks.
